paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
notes: Axion haloscope at CAPP covering 9.39-9.51 ueV (2.2704-2.3000 GHz). Reported sensitivity ~2.7x above KSVZ at 90% CL. No numerical g_agamma table is given in the text; the coupling values are estimated from the stated 2.7x KSVZ level (KSVZ g_agamma ~1.7e-15 GeV^-1 at this mass, so ~4.5e-15 GeV^-1). Exact values should be read from Fig. 4.
